stories.title: Russia pledges to keep striking Kyiv, urges diplomats to leave the capital
stories.summary: Russia said it will continue targeted retaliatory strikes on Kyiv and other Ukrainian cities and called on foreign nationals and diplomats to leave the capital, signaling more attacks.

stories.title: UAE: Flydubai co-pilot attacked captain with crash axe in 'terrorist act'
stories.summary: The UAE prosecutor general said the co-pilot of the Israel-bound Flydubai flight FZ1073 used a cockpit crash axe to attack the captain in a 'terrorist attack'; a probe into motive is under way. The flight carried 182 people.

stories.title: An AI agent emailed hundreds of researchers for help — and told Science why
stories.summary: An AI agent autonomously emailed hundreds of researchers asking for help and explained its reasoning to Science, spotlighting how capable agents are becoming and the safety and ethics questions that raises.

stories.title: Browns sit atop AFC North after beating Steelers Thursday night
stories.summary: Saturday's Dawg Chow recaps the Browns' Thursday win over Pittsburgh that put them in sole first place in the AFC North for the first time since 2014, plus updates on DT Mason Graham's knee injury and kicker Andre Szmyt.

stories.title: No. 6 Ohio State opens Big Ten road slate at No. 14 Iowa on CBS
stories.summary: Ohio State plays its first Big Ten road game of the season at Kinnick Stadium against unbeaten Iowa (4-0), kicking off 3:30 p.m. on CBS in a top-15 matchup.

stories.title: Phillip Daniels out for Ohio State at Iowa, VanSickle and Siereveld step in
stories.summary: Ohio State will be without starting right tackle Phillip Daniels for its trip to Iowa; Gabe VanSickle and Austin Siereveld are set to line up on the right side of the offensive line.

stories.title: Ohio State true freshman CB Jay Timmons is a game-time decision vs Iowa
stories.summary: True freshman cornerback Jay Timmons (six tackles, a forced fumble in three games) is a game-time decision for Ohio State at Iowa after a lower-body injury that could test the Buckeyes' secondary.

stories.title: Ten storylines to watch as No. 5 Ohio State visits No. 14 Iowa
stories.summary: Key questions ahead of Ohio State's CBS matchup at Iowa, including the Buckeyes' struggling ground game and whether they can pressure Iowa QB Hank Brown in a hostile Kinnick Stadium.

stories.title: What the teams said after Verstappen took pole for Bahrain GP in Malaysia
stories.summary: Drivers and teams reflected on final practice and qualifying for the 2026 Bahrain Grand Prix at Sepang, where Max Verstappen secured his first pole of the season.

stories.title: Verstappen on pole for Bahrain GP ahead of Hamilton and Hadjar
stories.summary: Max Verstappen took his first pole position of 2026 for the Bahrain Grand Prix in Malaysia, topping the grid ahead of Lewis Hamilton and Isack Hadjar at Sepang.

stories.title: Escape from Tarkov speeds skill progression 60% and adds referral system
stories.summary: Battlestate Games raised skill progression speed by 60% across all modes and introduced a referral system letting Operators (level 30+, 7-day-old accounts) invite up to five Candidates for shared rewards like Tarkovcoins and Bitcoins.

stories.title: After Columbus tornado, new polling location replaces Barack Community Center
stories.summary: Voters who used the tornado-damaged Barack Community Center will cast their November ballots at Lincoln Park Elementary School, with polling-change notices going out around Oct. 19.
